data.label: Employment Governed Record
data.description: An employment record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier, and the digital signature proof. Members: Employment Record; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov); Digital Signature Proof.

items.label: Digital Signature Proof
items.description: Cryptographic proof of attestation (digital signature)

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: Employment Record
items.description: An employment: the employee's national ID, the employer's business registry number, the NIEM employment association (position, department, status, dates, references), city, province and compensation. Members: National ID (CID); Business Registry Number; employment-association (NIEM); City; Province; Compensation.

items.label: Business Registry Number
items.description: Cordova Business Registration Number. Format: BIZ-NNNNNN where NNNNNN is a six-digit sequence number assigned at incorporation. Required for all business filings, tax records, and port authority transactions.

items.label: National ID (CID)
items.description: Cordova National Identity Number. Format: COR-PPCC-NNNNNN where PP is the two-letter province code (AL=Aldara, BR=Brevina, CE=Celara), CC is the two-digit city code (01-03), and NNNNNN is a six-digit sequence number. Issued at birth or naturalization. Required for all government transactions.

items.label: City
items.description: One of the nine cities in the Republic of Cordova.

items.label: Province
items.description: One of the three provinces of the Republic of Cordova. Used across civil registry, property, tax, and all geographic records.

items.label: Compensation
items.description: Compensation: salary in Córdobas and pay frequency. Members: Salary Amount; Pay Frequency.

items.label: Pay Frequency
items.description: How often the employee is paid

items.label: Salary Amount
items.description: Monthly gross salary or wage in Cordova Córdoba. Represents the agreed compensation amount before deductions for taxes, social security, and other withholdings.

items.label: Employment Association
items.description: A data type for an association between an employee and an employer. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentAssociationType. Members: Employee Reference; Employer Reference; Employee Identification; Employment Position; Employment Status; Employee Full Time Indicator; Employee Hours Weekly Quantity; Employee Hours Daily Quantity; Employment Pay Rate Amount; Employee Pay Hourly Indicator; Employee Occupation; Employee Rank; Employee Shift; Employment Length Duration; Employee Supervisor Reference; Employee Supervisor Indicator; Employment Location Reference; Employee Contact Information Reference.

items.label: Employee Full Time Indicator
items.description: True if a person has full-time employment; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeFullTimeIndicator.

items.label: Employee Pay Hourly Indicator
items.description: True if a person is paid on an hourly basis; false if a person is salaried. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeePayHourlyIndicator.

items.label: Employee Supervisor Indicator
items.description: True if the employee is a supervisor; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeSupervisorIndicator.

items.label: Employee Contact Information Reference
items.description: A means of contacting a person at work. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeContactInformation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Contact Information record.

items.label: Employee Identification
items.description: An employment identification number assigned to a person. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeIdentification. The identifier value (nc:IdentificationID).

items.label: Employee Occupation
items.description: A job of an employee. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeOccupationText.

items.label: Employee Rank
items.description: A rank, status, or promotion level of a person within an employment organization. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeRankText.

items.label: Employee Reference
items.description: A person who works for a business or a person. NIEM 6.0 nc:Employee. Holds the IRI of the referenced Person record.

items.label: Employee Shift
items.description: A set of hours or time frame during which a person usually works. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeShiftText.

items.label: Employee Supervisor Reference
items.description: A person who oversees and manages an employee. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeSupervisor. Holds the IRI of the referenced Person record.

items.label: Employer Reference
items.description: An organization or person that employs a person. NIEM 6.0 nc:Employer. Holds the IRI of the referenced Employer record.

items.label: Employment Location Reference
items.description: A location where a person works. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentLocation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Employment Status
items.description: A status of employment for a person. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentStatus. The status as text (nc:StatusText).

items.label: Employee Hours Daily Quantity
items.description: A number of hours spent at workplace or working in a typical work day. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeHoursDailyQuantity.

items.label: Employee Hours Weekly Quantity
items.description: A number of hours spent at workplace or working in a typical week. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmployeeHoursWeeklyQuantity.

items.label: Employment Pay Rate Amount
items.description: A monetary compensation a person receives for employment. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPayRateAmount. An amount of money in the Default currency units by slot.

items.label: Employment Length Duration
items.description: A duration over which the given employment has lasted. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentLengthDuration.

items.label: Employment Position
items.description: A data type for a job, post, or group of duties and responsibilities to be performed by an employee. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionType. Members: Employment Position Name; Employment Position Department Name; Employment Position Duty; Employment Position Basis Code; Employment Position Essential Indicator; Employment Position Temporary Indicator; Employment Position Identification; Employment Position Location Reference; Employment Position Required Education; Employment Position Required Job Skill.

items.label: Employment Position Essential Indicator
items.description: True if the employment position is deemed to perform an essential service; false otherwise. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionEssentialIndicator.

items.label: Employment Position Temporary Indicator
items.description: True if the position is temporary in nature; false if it is permanent. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionTemporaryIndicator.

items.label: Employment Position Department Name
items.description: A name of a department or other business unit associated with a job position. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionDepartmentName.

items.label: Employment Position Duty
items.description: A job duty that will be performed for an employment position. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionDutyText.

items.label: Employment Position Identification
items.description: An identification of an employment position. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionIdentification. The identifier value (nc:IdentificationID).

items.label: Employment Position Location Reference
items.description: A location for an employment position. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionLocation. Holds the IRI of the referenced Location record.

items.label: Employment Position Name
items.description: A job name or title of an employment position. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionName.

items.label: Employment Position Required Education
items.description: A kind of educational level or certification required for an employment position. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionRequiredEducationText.

items.label: Employment Position Required Job Skill
items.description: A job skill that is required for this position. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionRequiredJobSkillText.

items.label: Employment Position Basis Code
items.description: A nature or duration of the position, such as permanent, non-permanent, or contractor. NIEM 6.0 nc:EmploymentPositionBasisCode. Codes of nc:EmploymentPositionBasisCodeSimpleType (3 values).

items.label: PROV Activity
items.description: A PROV activity: what it was, when it ran, its status, and the entities, activities, agent and plan it relates to.

items.label: Activity Description
items.description: A description of what the activity does and why.

items.label: Activity Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV activity: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Activity Label
items.description: A human-readable label for a PROV activity.

items.label: Activity Location
items.description: Where the activity took place (prov:atLocation), as text.

items.label: Activity Type
items.description: The kind of activity, in the vocabulary of the domain (prov:type).

items.label: Error Message
items.description: The error the activity reported, if it failed.

items.label: Had Plan Reference
items.description: The plan the activity followed (prov:hadPlan). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Used Entity Reference
items.description: An entity the activity used (prov:used). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Associated With Reference
items.description: The agent associated with the activity (prov:wasAssociatedWith). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Ended By Reference
items.description: The entity that ended the activity (prov:wasEndedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Informed By Reference
items.description: An activity that informed this one (prov:wasInformedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Started By Reference
items.description: The entity that started the activity (prov:wasStartedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Activity Status
items.description: The state of an activity, from the Data Privacy Vocabulary activity status concepts.

items.label: Ended At
items.description: When the activity ended (prov:endedAtTime).

items.label: Started At
items.description: When the activity started (prov:startedAtTime).

items.label: PROV Agent
items.description: A PROV agent: a person, organization or software agent, with its identity, contact and delegation.

items.label: Acted On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The agent on whose behalf this agent acted (prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Agent Description
items.description: A description of the agent and its responsibilities.

items.label: Agent Email
items.description: The agent's email address (foaf:mbox).

items.label: Agent Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV agent: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Agent Name
items.description: The name of the agent (foaf:name).

items.label: Agent Organization Name
items.description: The organization the agent belongs to or is.

items.label: Software Name
items.description: The name of a software agent.

items.label: Software Version
items.description: The version of a software agent.

items.label: PROV Agent Type
items.description: The kind of PROV agent: person, organization or software agent.
